core_representative.selection: deterministic stratified proportional sampling by discipline

language_extension.selection: targeted unseen cases to improve language-band measurement without reusing boundary-review cases

excluded_from_evaluation.reason: used to validate/develop V1 rules; not blind

leakage_rules: Evaluation case IDs must not appear in rule supervision train/dev.
Evaluation case IDs must not appear in RAG corpus during evaluation.
Reported outcomes are never passed to the model during evaluation.

metrics_v1.reporting: Core and targeted extensions must be reported separately.
metrics_v1.overall: not scored in V1 because official overall ground truth is not defined
